title: PhD studentships in Computing Science (October 2027 entry)
institution: University of Glasgow, School of Computing Science

compensation.value: College Scholarships: home-level fees plus annual stipend of £22,437 (2027-28); Minerva: at least £22,000 per year
compensation.evidence_quote: College Scholarships ... annual stipend (£22,437 for session 2027-28); Minerva Scholarships ... living allowance of at least £22,000 per year

about: University of Glasgow School of Computing Science studentships for PhD research starting October 2027, including Excellence Bursaries, part-time Minerva Scholarships, College Scholarships and a China Scholarship Council route. Applications are due 31 January 2027.
requirements: For PhD students starting in October 2027 or shortly thereafter
Excellence Bursaries are fee scholarships (value deducted from tuition)
Minerva Scholarships are for part-time PhD students (5 years, research and teaching)
College Scholarships cover home-level fees and living costs at the UKRI rate
China Scholarship Council route available for Chinese students

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Computer science research" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"PhD research for students starting in October 2027" → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
